scope: Current official documentation, not independently attested frozen CANN 9.2 binary support
reviewed_facts: A3 and TP8 supported in documented product matrix
BF16 ND input, K5120 and N512 are not excluded by the listed generic dimensional conditions
FP32 projection inputs are not supported
AIV inference allowed but gather_output must be true; AI CPU no-gather-output option is listed for training
Stock output MM M is gathered padded local-M times world-size, not arbitrary trimmed global token count
